dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: Looks like we need to start by repairing its internal structures...

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: This Gardemek. Heinry says it's the Motorized Autonomous Fonta Vending Machine's bodyguard. He even tried to install a recording device in it...

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: But he should stick to making Fonta, it's all he's good at. I'm the only one who knows how to fix things.

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: Yeah, see you. I need to figure out how to fix this thing...

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: Yeah. We were both on the research team that developed Fonta.

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: The Institute didn't take the project very seriously and we couldn't get any resources or support... But the work was easy and fun.

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: Of course, when Fonta became a major commercial success the Institute started paying more attention.

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: After that, we founded the Fonta company, with the Institute's support... Although in practice we were managed by the Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: As for Heinry... All he thinks about is Fonta, so he doesn't care about any of that.

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: But as for me... Ah, forget it. Let's talk about something else.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know how to repair meka?

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: I used to work in a project team that built meka, but the project leads kept changing.

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: And every new lead would redo all the work from the beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: I just couldn't stand it, so I spoke to Heinry and eventually transferred to his Fonta project team.

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: Though I never thought I'd have to fix them again after all this time...

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: Oh, I brought some extra parts that I'm not going to use. Take them, maybe they'll come in handy.
